items.name: AGV (automated guided vehicle) for soldering pallets, magnetic-strip navigation, each with 40 m magnetic strip and charger
specs: Outer dimensions: 650 x 650 x 550 mm (L x W x H)
Load plate: 600 x 600 x 50 mm (L x W x H), carries the soldering pallet
Driving modes: straight line and turning
Running time: > 15 h; stand-by time: > 200 h; charging time: 4 h
Navigation: magnetic strip, forward and backward
Parameter setting: LCD touch screen or remote control
Branch route: min. turning radius 0.8 m at 90°
Magnetic navigation strip: 40 m per unit, included
Battery charger: one per unit, included

charges.name: Export packing: vacuum-sealed, fumigation-free wooden case

terms.payment: 50% T/T deposit with order, 50% T/T before shipment
terms.delivery: Within 30 days after receipt of the deposit
terms.warranty: 12 months from the date of shipment, excluding consumable and wear parts and damage caused by misuse
terms.installation: Free remote installation guidance and operator training by video call
terms.packing: Export packing as listed above. Freight from Shenzhen is arranged and paid by the buyer (EXW).
terms.insurance: To be covered by the buyer

notes: Photos are for reference; the machine supplied follows the specifications above.
